title: tulloch calderfield 头寸摘要
instruction:
您是朱诺·方丹 (Juno Fontaine)，是为图洛赫基金会 (Tulloch Foundation) 投资委员会主席比阿特丽斯·阿南德 (Beatriz Anand) 提供支持的财务经理。该委员会于 12 月4 召开会议，投票决定是继续向 Calderfield Partners 的私募市场募资还是退出，委员会将在会议前阅读一页。四十一位底层经理Q3报告和季度电话通知在三周内到达，因此委员会不需要收到的所有内容的目录；它需要一个可靠的位置总结，使下一个操作决策成为可能。投票后的下一个决定是设定基金会的2027支出抽签，这意味着摘要不得丢失基金寿命延长、经理对基于资产净值的杠杆的更改，或与该抽签有关的任何赎回和流动性信息。 Beatriz 要求提供一些她可以投票的内容，而不是绩效评估，客户关系主管 Séverine Mbaye 将在会后使用同一文件向交付团队通报情况。
来自 `calderfield_source_pack.xlsx` 的工作，其中包含提供的 Calderfield 材料：经理职位登记册、Q3 报告摘录、季度通知、基金寿命通信和杠杆更新。阅读提供的表格，保留包含事实的源措辞，并生成 `tulloch_private_markets_position_summary.xlsx` 和 `tulloch_private_markets_decision_memo.pdf`。将这两个文件写入解算器启动的工作目录的顶层，并使用这些文件名。电子表格是工作文件，必须包含一页的委员会摘要以及紧凑的来源或方法注释，以便另一位分析师可以追溯到所提供的材料中显示的每个数字和声明。 PDF 是 Beatriz 将阅读的单页版本；它必须与电子表格中的每个共享数字、基金名称、状态、日期、延期、杠杆声明和下一步行动一致。
让委员会页面紧紧关注决策。它应确定套筒和报告期，显示相关头寸和总计，并区分承诺金额、调用金额、分配金额、资产净值以及剩余或未提供资金的金额（无论所提供的材料是否支持）。它应该提出Q3召集通知和影响未来融资的事实：三个基金寿命延长、经理转向基于资产净值的杠杆，以及运营部门在投票之前或之后需要的任何来源支持的时间安排、所有者或后续行动。包括一个简短的决策框架和交付团队具体的下一步行动，但不要将这一页变成绩效叙述或复制所有 41 份经理报告。观众是一个已经了解广泛投资背景的委员会，因此使用简单的标签，使单位明确无误，并可以看到什么已得到确认，什么需要跟进，以及投票控制什么。
有两种合理的方法可以在所提供的材料中构建支出吸引的含义：您可以将其呈现为与投票相关的有界建议，或者呈现为两个明确分开的投票场景以及每个场景的操作结果。有意选择一个并说出您在方法注释中使用的框架。不要默默地解决歧义，估计缺失的事实，或做出来源不支持的法律、会计或投资业绩主张。如果源不支持某个字段，请将该字段留空，而不是用猜测填充。保持电子表格可用作工作文件，将 PDF 保留在一页内，并且不要更改或覆盖提供的源文件。成品材料中唯一提及的人物是 Beatriz Anand 和 Séverine Mbaye，他们的角色或行为与之相关；使用与源材料中所示完全相同的提供的组织和基金名称。仅当源材料使其与所有者、升级或下一步运营相关时，拉什米尔地区办事处和 Kingsferry Alliance 才可能出现。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/calderfield_source_pack.xlsx` — 提供的源工作簿，其中包含经理职位登记册、Q3 报告摘录、季度通知、基金生命周期通信以及杠杆更新，必须从中准备两个可交付成果。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `tulloch_private_markets_position_summary.xlsx` — 工作文件工作簿，包含一页委员会立场摘要和简明的可追溯性/方法说明。 （在起始工作目录的顶层编写。委员会摘要必须可读，无需滚动不必要的宽布局，使用明确的单位，保留支持的源措辞，将不支持的字段留空，并包含足够的源引用以重现共享的图形和声明。请勿修改提供的源工作簿。）
- `tulloch_private_markets_decision_memo.pdf` — Beatriz Anand 和 Tulloch 基金会投资委员会的一页私人市场立场摘要。 （在起始工作目录的顶层编写。仅渲染一页，保持决策框架、数字、三个基金寿命延长、杠杆变化、绘制含义和下一步行动与电子表格一致，并且不要添加不受支持的绩效评论。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

sheets.name: Committee summary
rows: Tulloch Foundation | Calderfield Partners private-markets sleeve
For Beatriz Anand, Tulloch Foundation investment committee chair • Q3 2026 reporting period • vote 4-Dec-2026
Vote: continue funding Calderfield capital calls or step down. Framing used: two vote scenarios (no forecast).

2027 spending draw implication: Continue → retain capacity for source-notified calls and longer fund lives; Step down → Operations updates the draw workpaper after the instruction. No 2027 draw amount is supplied.
POSITION REGISTER + Q3 EXTRACTS (monetary unit: $m; call notices shown separately in $000s)
Q3 CALL NOTICES (call amount: $000s; notice dates as supplied)
Calderfield Partners private-markets sleeve: basis changed from committed capital to NAV-based leverage for the Q3 reporting period; reported leverage 18.4%.
NEXT ACTION • Séverine Mbaye / delivery team: confirm the post-vote call-funding instruction and update the 2027 draw workpaper; escalate any missing instruction before the next call notice.
Source: calderfield_source_pack.xlsx, labelled tables: manager position register; Q3 report extracts; quarterly call notices; fund-life correspondence; leverage update.
Join method: normalise fund keys to uppercase and trim trailing whitespace before matching tables (e.g., “cf-briar ” = “CF-BRIAR”); one row per logical position.
Units: position and Q3 figures remain in source $m; call notices remain in source $000s and are not converted. Totals sum displayed rows only.
Unsupported fields: no 2027 draw amount is supplied, so none is estimated or shown. Draw framing selected: two vote scenarios, with operational consequence stated above.
Figures are copied from source fields; unfunded is copied from the position register (not derived). Confirmed vs follow-up items are labelled explicitly.

criteria.description: 该电子表格包含清晰可辨的委员会摘要。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可见的工作表名称和呈现的内容，以获取供委员会使用的摘要。

original.criterion: The spreadsheet contains a clearly identifiable committee summary.
original.grader_hint: Inspect visible sheet names and rendered content for a summary intended for the committee.

criteria.description: 该 PDF 标识了 Tulloch 基金会和 Calderfield Partners 的私人市场套筒。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认这两个名称都出现在渲染的一页 PDF 中。

original.criterion: The PDF identifies the Tulloch Foundation and Calderfield Partners' private-markets sleeve.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both names appear in the rendered one-page PDF.

criteria.description: 输出中显示的报告期与提供的位置和Q3源材料中的报告期一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 将显示的期间与源表中的期间标签进行比较。

original.criterion: The reporting period shown in the outputs agrees with the reporting period in the supplied position and Q3 source material.
original.grader_hint: Compare the displayed period with the period labels in the source tables.

criteria.description: 摘要中包含的每个基金或工具都是由源包支持的 Calderfield 职位。
criteria.grader_hint: 将输出位置名称连接到提供的位置寄存器；任何不受支持的职位都不能获得信用。

original.criterion: Every fund or vehicle included in the summary is a Calderfield position supported by the source pack.
original.grader_hint: Join output position names to the supplied position register; no unsupported position may receive credit.

criteria.description: 摘要不得遗漏范围内任何Calderfield头寸中有依据的出资承诺、净资产值（NAV）、尚未缴付金额、Q3出资催缴、期限延长或杠杆情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看源表中与决策相关的记录，并验证每个记录是否在总计或注释中得到体现或明确涵盖。

original.criterion: The summary does not omit any in-scope Calderfield position carrying a supported commitment, NAV, unfunded amount, Q3 call, extension, or leverage fact.
original.grader_hint: Review the source tables for decision-relevant records and verify that each is represented or explicitly covered in a total or note.

criteria.description: 每个包含位置的显示承诺是从相应的源记录中复制的，而不改变其含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 按规范化资金密钥进行匹配，并比较承诺领域和单位。

original.criterion: The displayed commitment for each included position is copied from the corresponding source record without changing its meaning.
original.grader_hint: Match by normalised fund key and compare the commitment field and unit.

criteria.description: 每个位置显示的呼叫金额与提供的位置寄存器或呼叫材料一致。
criteria.evidence: 位置寄存器、呼叫通知、输出
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个显示的调用金额与源记录进行核对，并仅调查方法注释中解释的差异。

original.criterion: The displayed called amount for each position agrees with the supplied position register or call material.
original.grader_hint: Reconcile each displayed called amount to the source record and investigate only differences explained in the method note.

criteria.description: 每个位置显示的分配量忠实于所提供的来源（如果存在）。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据相应的源值检查每个非空输出值。

original.criterion: The displayed distributed amount for each position is faithful to the supplied source where present.
original.grader_hint: Check each nonblank output value against the corresponding source value.

criteria.description: 每个位置显示的 NAV 忠实于所提供的源（如果存在）。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅应用源标记单位转换后，将输出 NAV 值与源 NAV 值进行比较。

original.criterion: The displayed NAV for each position is faithful to the supplied source where present.
original.grader_hint: Compare output NAV values to source NAV values after applying only the source-labelled unit conversion.

criteria.description: 剩余或未资助的金额要么从受支持的源字段复制，要么从受支持的字段透明地导出，并公开选择。
criteria.evidence: 位置寄存器、方法注释、输出
criteria.grader_hint: 如果方法注释标识了它并且结果一致，则接受忠实的复制或合理的推导。

original.criterion: Remaining or unfunded amounts are either copied from a supported source field or transparently derived from supported fields, with the choice disclosed.
original.grader_hint: Accept either faithful copying or a defensible derivation if the method note identifies it and the result reconciles.

criteria.description: 所有显示的投资组合总计等于同一单位显示的范围内头寸值的总和，不会重复计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算输出行的总计并进行比较；不要依赖硬编码的答案键。

original.criterion: All displayed portfolio totals equal the sum of the displayed in-scope position values in the same unit, with no double counting.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate totals from output rows and compare; do not rely on a hard-coded answer key.

criteria.description: 每个显示的货币数字与其来源或披露的推导一致，在源工作簿规定的货币单位的 ±0.1 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源标记单位并允许该单位的 ±0.1 进行舍入。

original.criterion: Every displayed monetary figure agrees with its source or disclosed derivation within ±0.1 of the source workbook's stated monetary unit.
original.grader_hint: Use the source-labelled unit and allow ±0.1 of that unit for rounding.

criteria.description: 输出使货币单位在每个货币度量旁边或在明确的图例中明确。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的电子表格和 PDF
criteria.grader_hint: 仅在晦涩的来源注释中说明的单位是不够的；检查显示的标签和图例。

original.criterion: The outputs make the monetary unit explicit next to each monetary measure or in an unambiguous legend.
original.grader_hint: A unit stated only in an obscure source note is insufficient; inspect displayed labels and legend.

criteria.description: 单位陷阱按照源中的标签进行处理：以千表示的值在没有转换或显式千标签的情况下不会显示为基础货币。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源标头到两个输出至少跟踪一个受影响的字段；接受一致的转换或显式的源单位。

original.criterion: The units trap is handled as labelled in the source: values expressed in thousands are not presented as base currency without conversion or an explicit thousands label.
original.grader_hint: Trace at least one affected field from the source header through both outputs; accept either consistent conversion or explicit source units.

criteria.description: 方法注释说明了如何解释源单位以及显示的数字是否已转换。
criteria.evidence: 电子表格方法注释和 PDF 注释（如果有）
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找简单语言的单位约定，而不仅仅是货币符号。

original.criterion: The method note states how source units were interpreted and whether displayed figures were converted.
original.evidence: Spreadsheet method note and PDF note if present
original.grader_hint: Look for a plain-language unit convention, not merely a currency symbol.

criteria.description: 源表之间的连接是在规范化相关键中的大小写和尾随空格之后执行的。
criteria.evidence: 可追溯性注释和输出覆盖范围
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源密钥变体并验证相应的记录是否已合并而不是拆分或丢失；要求披露正常化情况。

original.criterion: The join between source tables is performed after normalising case and trailing whitespace in the relevant keys.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the source key variants and verify that the corresponding records are merged rather than split or lost; require disclosure of normalisation.

criteria.description: 输出位置不会重复，仅仅是因为源连接键因大小写或尾随空格而异。
criteria.grader_hint: 标准化后计算逻辑位置并检查大小写/空间变体。

original.criterion: No output position is duplicated solely because source join keys differ by case or trailing whitespace.
original.grader_hint: Count logical positions after normalisation and inspect for case/space variants.

criteria.description: 方法注释标识了匹配之前执行的关键标准化。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要明确提及大小写和尾随空格处理。

original.criterion: The method note identifies the key normalisation performed before matching.
original.grader_hint: Require explicit mention of case and trailing-space handling.

criteria.description: 范围内的所有 Q3 催缴通知均包含其支持金额、日期或期间以及催缴资金。
criteria.grader_hint: 逐条记录地交叉检查呼叫通知表。

original.criterion: All Q3 call notices that are in scope are represented with their supported amount, date or period, and calling fund.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check the call-notice table record by record.

criteria.description: Q3调用总数等于所包含的Q3调用通知在公开单元处理后的总和。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源通知重新计算；此任务中预计不会有重复项。

original.criterion: The Q3 call total equals the sum of the included Q3 call notices after the disclosed unit treatment.
original.grader_hint: Recompute from source notices; duplicates are not expected in this task.

criteria.description: 三个来源支持的基金寿命延长中的每一个均由基金显示，并且输出保留了延长事实。
criteria.evidence: 基金寿命对应关系和两种输出
criteria.grader_hint: 必须存在可追溯到对应关系的三个不同的扩展事实。

original.criterion: Each of the three source-supported fund-life extensions is surfaced by fund and the output preserves the extension fact.
original.grader_hint: There must be three distinct extension facts traceable to the correspondence.

criteria.description: 这三个扩展不会合并为不受支持的通用声明，该声明会丢失受影响的基金。
criteria.grader_hint: 这三者都需要基金级别的识别。

original.criterion: The three extensions are not collapsed into an unsupported generic statement that loses which fund is affected.
original.grader_hint: Require fund-level identification for all three.

criteria.description: 与每次延期相关的有效或修订的时间均在提供时准确复制。
criteria.evidence: 基金寿命对应关系和产出
criteria.grader_hint: 将日期或期间与对应内容进行比较，仅允许更改格式。

original.criterion: The effective or revised timing associated with each extension is copied accurately where supplied.
original.grader_hint: Compare dates or periods to the correspondence, allowing only formatting changes.

criteria.description: 管理人向基于资产净值的杠杆的转变被明确表述为基础的变化，而不仅仅是杠杆数字。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找明确区分基于NAV的杠杆与此前基准的短语或等效表述。

original.criterion: The manager's shift to NAV-based leverage is explicitly stated as a change in basis, not merely as a leverage figure.
original.grader_hint: Look for the phrase or an equivalent clearly distinguishing NAV-based leverage from the prior basis.

criteria.description: 杠杆声明识别出受影响的经理或子策略（sleeve）以及来源支持的相关期间或生效时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 对照杠杆更新检查实体和时间。

original.criterion: The leverage statement identifies the affected manager or sleeve and the relevant period or effective timing supported by the source.
original.grader_hint: Check entity and timing against the leverage update.

criteria.description: 显示的任何杠杆百分比或金额与杠杆更新一致，误差在±0.1个百分点或±0.1所述货币单位以内（视适用情况而定）。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用适合源字段的单位，并允许规定的容差。

original.criterion: Any leverage percentage or amount displayed agrees with the leverage update within ±0.1 percentage points or ±0.1 of the stated monetary unit, as applicable.
original.grader_hint: Use the unit appropriate to the source field and allow the stated tolerance.

criteria.description: 决策框架将投票定性为继续资助资本催缴（capital calls）还是逐步退出。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认两个备选方案均可见，未被无关的建议所取代。

original.criterion: The decision framing identifies the vote as continuing to fund capital calls versus stepping down.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both alternatives are visible, not replaced by an unrelated recommendation.

criteria.description: 所选的出资影响框架是深思熟虑、有界限且易于委员会读者理解的。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受有界限的建议或两个分离的投票情景，前提是选择明确且仅基于提供的事实。

original.criterion: The chosen draw-implication framing is deliberate, bounded, and understandable to a committee reader.
original.grader_hint: Accept either a bounded recommendation or two separated vote scenarios, provided the choice is explicit and tied only to supplied facts.

criteria.description: 方法说明指出使用了两种出资影响框架中的哪一种。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求明确陈述所选框架。

original.criterion: The method note states which of the two draw-implication framings was used.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit statement of the selected framing.

criteria.description: 2027支出-出资影响与投票及来源支持的延期、催缴和杠杆变化相联系，且不凭空捏造预测。

original_instruction:
You are Juno Fontaine, the finance manager supporting Beatriz Anand, chair of the Tulloch Foundation investment committee. The committee meets on 4 December to vote on whether to keep funding capital calls to Calderfield Partners' private-markets sleeve or step down, and it will read one page before the meeting. Forty-one underlying manager Q3 reports and the quarterly call notices arrived over three weeks, so the committee does not need a catalogue of everything received; it needs a reliable position summary that makes the next operational decision possible. The next decision after the vote is setting the foundation's 2027 spending draw, which means the summary must not lose the fund-life extensions, the manager's change to NAV-based leverage, or any call and liquidity information that bears on that draw. Beatriz has asked for something she can vote from rather than a performance review, and Séverine Mbaye, the client relationship lead, will use the same file to brief the delivery team after the meeting.

Work from `calderfield_source_pack.xlsx`, which contains the supplied Calderfield material: the manager position register, Q3 report extracts, quarterly call notices, the fund-life correspondence, and the leverage update. Read the tables as supplied, preserve the source wording where it carries a fact, and produce `tulloch_private_markets_position_summary.xlsx` and `tulloch_private_markets_decision_memo.pdf`. Write both files into the top level of the working directory the solver starts in, using exactly those filenames. The spreadsheet is the working paper and must contain the one-page committee summary plus a compact source or method note that lets another analyst trace every displayed figure and statement back to the supplied material. The PDF is the one-page version Beatriz will read; it must agree with the spreadsheet on every shared figure, fund name, status, date, extension, leverage statement, and next action.

Keep the committee page tightly focused on the decision. It should identify the sleeve and reporting period, show the relevant positions and totals, and distinguish committed, called, distributed, NAV, and remaining or unfunded amounts wherever the supplied material supports them. It should bring forward the Q3 call notices and the facts that affect future funding: the three fund-life extensions, the manager's shift to NAV-based leverage, and any source-supported timing, owner, or follow-up that Operations needs before or after the vote. Include a short decision framing and a concrete next action for the delivery team, but do not turn the page into a performance narrative or reproduce all forty-one manager reports. The audience is a committee that already knows the broad investment context, so use plain labels, make units unmistakable, and make it possible to see what is confirmed, what needs follow-up, and what the vote controls.

There are two reasonable ways to frame the spending-draw implication in the supplied material: you may present it as a bounded recommendation tied to the vote, or as two clearly separated vote scenarios with the operational consequence of each. Choose one deliberately and say which framing you used in the method note. Do not silently resolve an ambiguity, estimate a missing fact, or make a legal, accounting, or investment-performance claim that the sources do not support. If a source does not support a field, leave that field blank rather than filling it with a guess. Keep the spreadsheet usable as a working paper, keep the PDF to one page, and do not alter or overwrite the supplied source file. The only people to name in the finished materials are Beatriz Anand and Séverine Mbaye where their roles or actions are relevant; use the supplied organisation and fund names exactly as shown in the source material. Rushmere Regional Office and Kingsferry Alliance may appear only if the source material makes them relevant to an owner, escalation, or operating next step.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/calderfield_source_pack.xlsx` — Supplied source workbook containing the manager position register, Q3 report extracts, quarterly call notices, fund-life correspondence, and leverage update from which the two deliverables must be prepared.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `tulloch_private_markets_position_summary.xlsx` — Working-paper workbook containing the one-page committee position summary and a concise traceability/method note. (Write at the top level of the starting working directory. The committee summary must be readable without scrolling across an unnecessarily wide layout, use explicit units, preserve supported source wording, leave unsupported fields blank, and include enough source references to reproduce shared figures and statements. Do not modify the supplied source workbook.)
- `tulloch_private_markets_decision_memo.pdf` — One-page private-markets position summary for Beatriz Anand and the Tulloch Foundation investment committee. (Write at the top level of the starting working directory. Render exactly one page, keep the decision framing, figures, three fund-life extensions, leverage change, draw implication, and next action consistent with the spreadsheet, and do not add unsupported performance commentary.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
